evidence.description: Captured history has repeated (dataset_id, observed_at) keys under distinct probe cycle values; consumers must retain cycle identity rather than treating observed_at alone as a unique observation key.

impact_on_claim_or_decision: An archive keyed only by dataset_id and observed_at can collapse distinct probe cycles into one observation and undercount historical evidence.
resolution_or_quarantine: Preserve cycle as part of historical observation identity; do not rewrite captured history.
rule_or_policy_change: The verifier requires at least one duplicate observation key with distinct cycle values in local history.

regression_test.description: A synthetic shared observation key passes only when its cycle values differ.
